name: Glyphic Scroll
summary: In Deathknell, Isabella summons newly awakened Forsaken mages to her in the ruined church. Her sealed scroll calls them to hone their volatile arcane powers.

sections.title: A Summons to the Arcane
sections.body: Isabella calls newly awakened Forsaken mages to the ruined church in Deathknell. After you show an affinity for arcane magic while fighting the mindless Scourge nearby, the scroll bearing her arcane sigil bids you to report to her. Isabella trains local mages, and she knows that untrained magic can endanger the Forsaken as much as their enemies.

sections.title: Wielding Magic in Undeath
sections.body: In Deathknell’s ruined chapel, Isabella teaches new Forsaken mages that undeath has not ended the dangers of arcane magic. Their bodies have lost the frailties of life, but magic remains volatile and corrupting. For the Forsaken, mastering the arcane is more than study. It can help them survive, seek vengeance, reclaim their destiny, and destroy those who threaten their fragile return to Lordaeron.

faq.answer: The Glyphic Scroll bears Isabella’s personal seal and calls newly awakened Forsaken mages to report to her in Deathknell’s ruined church to advance their arcane studies.

faq.q: Who sends the Glyphic Scroll to you?
faq.answer: Isabella, the mage trainer in Deathknell, sends the scroll to you after you deal with the nearby mindless Scourge.
Isabella is inside the ruined village church in the center of Deathknell, alongside other trainers who guide newly risen Forsaken.

faq.q: Why does Isabella warn you about magical corruption?
aliases: why is magic dangerous to undead
faq.answer: Isabella warns you that arcane magic remains volatile and can corrupt or consume the Forsaken. Mastering it takes discipline and will.

faq.q: Why is arcane magic important to the Forsaken in Deathknell?
faq.answer: Forsaken mages use arcane power to reclaim Lordaeron and defend their freedom from the mindless Scourge, hostile living mortals, and the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: Can any Forsaken class receive this scroll?
faq.answer: No. Only Forsaken mages receive the Glyphic Scroll, which summons them to their trainer in Deathknell.

angles.text: As a Mage, you receive this scroll as your summons to Isabella. Your magic serves the survival and resurgence of your newly freed people.
As an Undead, you wield the arcane to help reclaim your stolen homeland. For the Forsaken, magic is a weapon, not a scholarly game of Dalaran.
